plat-01 severity per doc 06 s2.1 / doc 05 s6: hard if process_env_populated=false, warn if unknown, adv if true. a-jsonc => adv; b-toml => hard; c-json => hard (wrangler.json is readable but has no compat date or flags, so populated=false). Doc 10 test 2.2 lists the three severities as hard / warn / adv; if the pack treats a config without compatibility_date as unknown, c-json would be warn. Pack author decides; this file records the doc 05 literal reading.
process.env is read only on the /debug route (src/index.ts:16) so the runtime tests pass in all variants (process is undefined at runtime in b-toml and c-json, which is exactly the hard finding).
